REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MAY 26, 2011 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
8.
Approval of Minutes
9A.
Ordinance for second reading and approval. ORDINANCE 960 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE BOARD OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM
10.
PUBLIC WORKS ACTIVITIES
10A.
Consideration of award of a contract for the installtion of playground surfacing at Gridley Park and replacement of perimeter windscreens at Cerritos High School tennis courts.
10B.
Consideration and award of contract for sidewalk, curb, gutter, and wheelchair ramp repairs in the City of Cerritos.
10C.
Consideration and review of the City of Cerritos 2010 Consumer Confidence Report.
10D.
Presentation by the County Sanitation Districts of Los Angeles County to review the Gridley Road Interceptor Sewer Project across portions of 166th Street, Gridley Road, Artesia Boulevard, 183rd Street and Pioneer Boulevard.
11.
NEW AND OLD BUSINESS
11A.
Consideration and review of a Professional Services Agreement by and between Mobilitie, LLC, the City of Cerritos, and The Planning Center, for environmental review services in connection with a proposed T-Mobile Wireless Telecommunication Permit (WTP) application, with the full cost of the Professional Services to be paid by the applicant.
12.
REPORT ON PENDING LEGISLATION
13.
CITY COUNCIL COMMUNICATIONS/COMMITTEE REPORTS/REPORT ON MEETINGS
14A.
CLOSED SESSION - Conference with Legal Counsel-Anticipated Litigation. Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to subdivision (b) of Section 54956.9. Number of potential cases: One (1)
15.
ADJOURNMENT
